 Medium
 Large
 Print Sonakshi Sinha has joined the conversation around Rahul Gandhi ’s childhood anecdote about his parents, Sonia Gandhi and Rajiv Gandhi , with a humorous reaction of her own. The actress joked that her future children would have to grow up seeing plenty of public displays of affection after Rahul recalled how his mother would sit on his father’s lap during family meals. Sonakshi took to Instagram to share her reaction, reposting a post by the handle Woemaniyah. The original post questioned why Sonia sitting on Rajiv’s lap during lunch had become such a talking point. Adding her own take, Sonakshi wrote, “Dammmmn my future kids have no idea whats comin their way. Buckle up kiddos (wherever you’ll are right now)." Watch Sonakshi Sinha Playfully Hits Husband Zaheer Iqbal, Sparks Reactions Rahul had shared the anecdote at the launch of Sonia Gandhi’s book, Belonging: A Journey of Love, in New Delhi on November 16. Recalling his parents’ equation, he said Sonia would often sit on Rajiv’s lap during lunch and dinner, even in the presence of other people. “There would be Papa, and on Papa’s lap, there would be Mama… Now, I thought this was a normal thing. So I would go to my friend’s house, but their parents wouldn’t be sitting on each other’s lap, and I’d ask my friend, ‘What is going on? Why is your mother not sitting on your father’s lap?’" he said. He further shared that he and his sister Priyanka grew up watching their parents openly express their affection. Rahul also recalled that he had seen them argue only once. The disagreement took place while Rajiv was speaking to former Punjab Chief Minister Captain Amarinder Singh over the phone. Sonia was trying to convey something to him and had to repeat herself several times. “Papa got stressed, and that was the fight," Rahul recalled. Join conversation

 Rahul later responded to the discussion around his remarks by sharing a photograph of a 12th-century sculpture at Karnataka’s Hoysaleswara Temple, depicting Goddess Parvati seated on Lord Shiva’s lap. Sharing the image, he wrote, “Fear, anger and hatred have woven a web in the hearts of BJP and RSS supporters that stops them from experiencing and expressing love. As a true Hindu, it is my duty to free them from this web, so that they too can start to experience the breathtaking beauty and joy of love and belonging in their lives. Satyam Shivam Sundaram." On the work front, Sonakshi Sinha was last seen in Tu Hai Meri Kiran, co-starring her husband Zaheer Iqbal . The film failed to make an impact at the box office.
